questions.solution_text:
$m = \dfrac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$
$= \dfrac{3 - (-1)}{-4 - (-4)}$
$= \dfrac{4}{0}$
Dividing by $0$ is undefined, so the gradient is **undefined**.
